name: io.github.eduardomv13.coyote-panel
displayName: DG-LAB Coyote Panel for VRChat Avatars
description: An in-game control panel for a DG-LAB Coyote 3.0: two intensity sliders (A/B), +/- buttons and a frequency control, held in a hand, installed on a VRChat avatar through Modular Avatar. Talks to the coyote-vrchat PC program over VRChat OSC. PC only. Read the safety notes before using it.
